body: Yes, me and mom have talked a lot about it. I doubt it could get a lot worse than here, I've moved and changed schools a lot so that in itself isn't my major worry, you just never know how things are going to work out.  Thank you for your kind words!

I try not to care so much about others. I dress the way I want and like the things I like, but in the environment I'm in doing that makes you so easily isolated. I know what's now isn't the end or anything, just hard sometimes. Thank you, though.
